sourceFits.n0: Saved zero-update initialization; no optimizer steps.
sourceFits.n16_32_64_128: Early-prefix results: independent fresh fits, seed 0, minibatch RNG 33000, 500 updates, H32; prefix shorter than H uses available shorter suffix examples.
sourceFits.n256_512_768_1280_2304: H32 horizon-extension fits documented in toy_verifier_paths_junction32.json and horizon_extension.json; same fixed scene/candidate set, 500 updates per fit.
sourceFits.n1024_2048_5096: Exact nested-prefix fits, seed 0/minibatch RNG 33000, 500 updates, H32; existing n64 predictions bitwise match and source prefix preservation audited.
sourceFits.n4096: Late-prefix run, seed 0, H32, 500 updates; this endpoint was selected as the first tested data prefix where the three methods all chose oracle top-four on this illustrative scene.

sourceMetadata.modelCheckpointStatus: Trained PyTorch model weight files are not present for the H32 junction fits. Exported per-candidate scores are the saved predictions_n*.npz outputs; fit protocol and result audit JSONs are bundled.
limitations: Single selected seed and fixed illustrative junction; not aggregate evidence.
The late 4096-transition endpoint was selected using this scene and top-four criterion.
Each nonzero training budget is an independent fresh fit on a nested prefix, not a sequential optimizer checkpoint.
The 32-step candidate paths are actual MuJoCo replay coordinates; no display smoothing is applied to exported coordinates.
